title: rest: list export writes every boolean cell as the literal 是 / 否, whatever the caller's language
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207, the maintainer's browser round on ObjectStack 18.0.0 (「hotcrm 升级到 objectstack 18.0 然后重新安排一轮浏览器测试」). Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-02** of track 1 (the full functional pass), by the cloud tester `session_019R3C7cvMNrmxf1AwtEt7N2`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `16c28664` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install with demo staff. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-v18-full-pass` at `dda91814d` ([`REPORT.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/dda91814dfe304ec48e616f5886491ecd7e8ade3/qa/2026-10-20-v18-full/REPORT.md)), which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL / steps:**
  - The same file as the contact-label card from this round: service.manager, English UI, All Cases → Export as CSV.
  - Also na.rep, who never changed language: `GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead/export?format=csv&fields=full_name,is_converted,do_not_call,…` with `Accept-Language: en-US`.
- **Expected:** the file speaks the caller's language. In the same file, the column headers ("SLA Violated", "Escalated", "Converted") and the select labels are English.
- **Actual:** every boolean cell is `是` or `否`, for example `…,2026-10-18 08:00:00,是,是,Tomas Okafor` and `Wren Halvorsen,是,否,…`.
- **Evidence:** [`81-ADM-005-export-csv-content.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/dda91814dfe304ec48e616f5886491ecd7e8ade3/qa/2026-10-20-v18-full/shots/81-ADM-005-export-csv-content.png); the REST output quoted above.
- **Reach:** every list export and `GET /api/v1/data/:object/export`, for every caller.

## Seat review (source at 18.0.0, `06cab4849`)

- The cell formatter hard-codes the literals, at `packages/rest/src/export-format.ts:368-371`:
  ```
  if (value === true || value === 'true' || value === 1) return '是';
  if (value === false || value === 'false' || value === 0) return '否';
  ```
- `formatCellValue(value, meta?, timezone?)` (`:360-364`) takes no locale. The route localizes only the schema (`data-action-routes.ts:1110-1114`, `translateMetaItem`), so headers and select labels follow the caller and boolean cells do not (`:1289`, `formatRowCells(row, cols, metaMap, timezone)`).
- The sibling door already picks by locale: `packages/rest/src/import-template.ts:430, :477, :511` (`booleanWords` `['yes','no']` for en, `['是','否']` for zh, `templateText(locale)`).
- Re-import reads `yes` / `no` / `是` (`packages/spec` `import-coercion.ts:29`), so a localized export stays importable.
- Unchanged on `main`.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24940) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13272), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-20T16:00Z`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Related, closed: objectstack-ai/objectstack#2481 (it specified 是/否); objectstack-ai/objectstack#2916 (export/import i18n, which did not cover boolean cells).
- Different: objectstack-ai/objectui#12924 (the inverse symptom in a client grid).
- **New.**
